content: The axe must strike the timber where the grain allows, not where stubborn fury commands.
author: Celtic & Norse Proverbs
explanation: If a woodcutter hacks wildly against the grain of an oak trunk, his iron blade chips, his shoulders strain, and the wood splits into ruined splinters. The master woodworker reads the grain, aligns with the natural flow, and splits the log with effortless precision.
practicalInsight: Do not force a solution with brute aggression today. Study the natural grain of the situation and work with it.
reflectionPrompt: Where are you exhausting yourself hacking against the grain of reality instead of finding the natural seam?
